reason: The reported specification does not control for the pre-period outcome (export_growth_2020) and trims the top and bottom 1% of the outcome, so it is not a full-sample estimate. It uses no post-treatment controls. My re-runs on the full sample, with and without export_growth_2020 and the other 2020 covariates, give coefficients of about 0.05 to 0.12 with p above 0.6, which is consistent with 'no effect'. The report should be redone and re-submitted with the pre-period outcome control and the full sample before release.
